palette_scope: All widget types; inherited global palette or per-instance override. Weather defaults to automatic scene.

outputs.title: 날씨·시간대별 배경
outputs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished Tempos CONCEPT01 companion design board, matching the supplied widget sheet's calm Galaxy-weather-inspired matte gradients, round corners, clean white numerals, navy Korean headings, pale blue-gray #EEF3F9 presentation background. Flat front view, no perspective, no device/browser/app frame. This is a static design exploration, not a working application. Crisp Korean.
Landscape canvas with enough height for THREE rows of THREE identical M widgets (9 total), each card proportion21:10 (336x160DIP logical size). Keep all9 cards at identical display scale, equal aligned gaps, generous margins. Each has an OUTSIDE label above it, not extra product text inside. Header "TEMPOS / CONCEPT 01". Footer "디자인 시안 · 샘플 데이터". Avoid heavy shadows, glass, photorealism, noise, cinematic scenery, branded logos, code/API labels.
Input image1 role: visual family reference, specifically its M weather card. Redesign into a3x3 WEATHER STATE comparison board. Title "날씨에 따라 바뀌는 배경", small subtitle "같은 위젯 · 날씨와 시간대에 맞춘 표현".
Every card preserves one clean layout: left "서울", large temperature, short weather text; right a LARGE SIMPLE FLAT weather icon and low-contrast background decoration. Thin translucent vertical divider. No forecast, no high/low temperatures needed on this state board. Don't place decoration behind essential text.
Row1:
1 outside label "맑은 낮". Sky blue gradient #286BCC to #6EA5D1, bright yellow sun, few very subtle light bands; inside "23°", "맑음".
2 outside "흐린 낮". Soft slate-blue gradient #587487 to #879BA8, layered flat clouds, inside "19°", "흐림".
3 outside "비 오는 낮". Rain-blue gradient #315572 to #638394, cloud with visible static diagonal raindrops mainly at right; inside "17°", "비".
Row2:
4 outside "눈 오는 낮". Cool blue-lavender gradient #647DA5 to #93A9BD, cloud and few static white snowflakes, maintain white text contrast using a slightly darker left region; inside "-2°", "눈".
5 outside "맑은 밤". Deep indigo #243762 to #52638C, pale cream crescent moon and3-5small star dots at right, inside "14°", "맑음".
6 outside "비 오는 밤". Deep navy rain gradient #24394F to #435E79, cloud with static drops, subtle crescent partially occluded by cloud, no visible stars; inside "12°", "비".
Row3:
7 outside "뇌우". Muted indigo #383F63 to #626B88, cloud rain and a single restrained pale-yellow lightning-bolt icon (STATIC, not glowing), inside "18°", "뇌우".
8 outside "안개". Muted blue-gray #607D89 to #91A4AC with faint horizontal mist bands only at right, flat fog glyph, inside "11°", "안개".
9 outside "해 질 무렵". Restrained lavender-to-peach gradient #665888 to #B58D9B, a small low sun with simple horizon arc at right, inside "20°", "맑음".
Keep ALL nine cards recognizably the same family. Weather decoration changes the card background, not just the tiny icon. Moon/night must not erase rain. No streaming rain or snow animations implied, use sparse static vector-like motifs, preserving the low-resource product direction. No extra label outside canvas, noGoogleorSamsungword.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished Tempos CONCEPT01 companion design board, matching the supplied widget sheet's calm Galaxy-weather-inspired matte gradients, round corners, clean white numerals, navy Korean headings, pale blue-gray #EEF3F9 presentation background. Flat front view, no perspective, no device/browser/app frame. This is a static design exploration, not a working application. Crisp Korean.
Landscape canvas with enough height for THREE rows of THREE identical M widgets (9 total), each card proportion21:10 (336x160DIP logical size). Input image1 role: style and layout reference for the CPU M widget only. Design a NEW3x3 board comparing NINE interchangeable color themes on the SAME CPU M widget. Board title "모든 위젯에 적용하는 테마", subtitle "위젯 종류와 색상은 별개".

Palette labels and gradients in reading order3rows:
1. "스카이" gradient #286BCC to #6EA5D1.
2. "블루" gradient #2550AD to #668BCA.
3. "코발트" gradient #315DD1 to #6C7CC5.
4. "인디고" gradient #445AB0 to #8188BB.
5. "틸" gradient #277D91 to #72ACA9.
6. "슬레이트" gradient #426780 to #819CAF.
7. "오션" gradient #256F9B to #70A7C7.
8. "스틸" gradient #476CB0 to #849FC6.
9. "라벤더" gradient #7952B5 to #A28BCD.
All white text must remain readable. No icons or information moved between theme variants. This communicates any widget can use any of these color themes. Footer additionally "전체 적용 · 위젯별 지정 가능".
